format: The judge vectors of Genkan (mode 1). A context is "GNKC" action:u8, venues:u8 then that many str, assets:u8 then that many str cap:u128, with no byte after; actions 1 commit, 2 defer, 3 abstain; no name twice in a list. A mode 1 request is "GNKQ" 1 ctx:sec order:sec, with no byte after. The sections: contexts that decode, with their fields; contexts that do not; the orders of the cases beyond gnk1.json; the cases, a context and an order named here or in gnk1.json, each with the kernel's line; mode 1 requests the kernel refuses; fields encodeContext refuses. The hex was computed from the formats by a throwaway script independent of src/frame.ts and of the kernel; the lines were written by hand from the judge's rules.

invalid.name: ctx-magic-alone
invalid.why: the action, the venues and the assets are missing

invalid.name: ctx-magic-of-an-order
invalid.why: GNK1 is the magic of an order

invalid.name: ctx-venues-count-one-more
invalid.why: four venues are announced, three follow

invalid.name: ctx-venues-count-one-less
invalid.why: two venues are announced, three follow

invalid.name: ctx-assets-count-one-more
invalid.why: four assets are announced, three follow

invalid.name: ctx-assets-count-one-less
invalid.why: two assets are announced, three follow

requests.name: judge-request-mode-1-three-secs
requests.why: mode 1 holds two secs, no byte after

requests.name: judge-request-mode-1-one-byte-after
requests.why: no byte follows the order's sec

requests.name: judge-request-mode-1-ctx-length-one-more
requests.why: the ctx's length takes a byte of the order's sec

requests.name: judge-request-mode-1-order-length-one-more
requests.why: the order's sec announces one byte more than follows

requests.name: judge-request-mode-1-order-length-one-less
requests.why: a byte follows the order's sec

unencodable.name: fields-ctx-action-upper-case
unencodable.why: the actions are commit, defer and abstain, lower case

unencodable.name: fields-ctx-venues-256
unencodable.why: a list holds at most 255 names

unencodable.why: a list holds at most 255 names
